<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="goldGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFC54D"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Underlying app screen -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="740" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="78" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Discover</text>
    <circle cx="343" cy="68" r="19" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="63" r="5" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="343" cy="74" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#939393"/>
    <rect x="24" y="101" width="342" height="46" rx="23" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="124" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="54" y1="130" x2="60" y2="136" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="72" y="130" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#939393">Search people and places</text>
    <rect x="24" y="168" width="342" height="178" rx="18" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="301" cy="196" r="23" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".85"/>
    <polygon points="281,315 320,258 340,281 361,260 366,315" fill="#939393" opacity=".6"/>
    <circle cx="325" cy="215" r="9" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <text x="42" y="207" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Meet someone new</text>
    <text x="42" y="232" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF">Your next connection could be here.</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="372" x2="366" y2="372" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="24" y="405" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Recommended for you</text>
    <text x="316" y="405" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FE3675">See All</text>
    <circle cx="60" cy="450" r="27" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <text x="60" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">M</text>
    <circle cx="132" cy="450" r="27" fill="#96E063"/>
    <text x="132" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">A</text>
    <circle cx="204" cy="450" r="27" fill="#4396F7"/>
    <text x="204" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">J</text>
    <circle cx="276" cy="450" r="27" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <text x="276" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">S</text>
    <circle cx="348" cy="450" r="27" fill="#C42936"/>
    <text x="348" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">L</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,794 52,783 65,794 65,810 39,810" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="35,795 52,780 69,795" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="52" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#4A4A4A">Home</text>
    <circle cx="130" cy="796" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="139" y1="805" x2="148" y2="814" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="130" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Explore</text>
    <circle cx="214" cy="796" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="207,796 212,801 222,790" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="214" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
    <circle cx="302" cy="790" r="6" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="302" cy="806" rx="14" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="302" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Darkened backdrop -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".42"/>

  <!-- Paywall panel -->
  <rect x="8" y="48" width="374" height="750" rx="28" fill="#000000" opacity=".16"/>
  <rect x="8" y="42" width="374" height="750" rx="28" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="334" y1="15" x2="338" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="12" x2="341" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="9" x2="345" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="357" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="17" x2="360" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="9" width="17" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="372" y="11" width="11" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="387" y="12" width="2" height="5" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Close button and branding -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="35" cy="72" r="17" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="66" x2="41" y2="78" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="41" y1="66" x2="29" y2="78" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="185,57 192,68 188,68 194,78 182,70 186,70" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="203" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">tinder</text>
    <rect x="303" y="59" width="56" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFF7D9"/>
    <text x="331" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">GOLD</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Promotional image card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="101" width="322" height="199" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity=".13"/>
    <rect x="34" y="96" width="322" height="199" rx="20" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <circle cx="292" cy="132" r="31" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18"/>
    <circle cx="307" cy="157" r="16" fill="#EFC54D" opacity=".8"/>
    <polygon points="50,295 120,205 167,253 214,198 284,295" fill="#C42936" opacity=".62"/>
    <polygon points="172,295 232,232 267,265 304,222 356,295" fill="#FE3675" opacity=".72"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="144" r="29" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".88"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="136" r="9" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <ellipse cx="88" cy="157" rx="16" ry="9" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <circle cx="150" cy="167" r="34" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".92"/>
    <circle cx="150" cy="157" r="10" fill="#4396F7"/>
    <ellipse cx="150" cy="180" rx="18" ry="10" fill="#4396F7"/>
    <rect x="51" y="112" width="91" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".94"/>
    <text x="96" y="129" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">TINDER GOLD</text>
    <text x="195" y="143" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Like who</text>
    <text x="195" y="169" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">likes you.</text>
    <text x="195" y="193" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FFFFFF">See your Likes before you match.</text>
    <circle cx="325" cy="265" r="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="321,265 325,269 332,261" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="329" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Upgrade to Tinder Gold</text>
  <text x="195" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#939393">More matches. More control. More fun.</text>

  <!-- Feature row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="75" cy="394" r="23" fill="#FFF7D9"/>
    <polygon points="75,378 79,389 91,390 82,397 85,409 75,402 65,409 68,397 59,390 71,389" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <text x="75" y="433" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">See Likes</text>
    <text x="75" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">before matching</text>

    <circle cx="195" cy="394" r="23" fill="#FFE8ED"/>
    <polygon points="195,374 201,387 215,389 205,398 208,411 195,404 182,411 185,398 175,389 189,387" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="195" y="433" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Unlimited</text>
    <text x="195" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">likes</text>

    <circle cx="315" cy="394" r="23" fill="#E8F2FF"/>
    <circle cx="315" cy="394" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#4396F7" stroke-width="3"/>
    <polyline points="315,387 315,395 321,399" fill="none" stroke="#4396F7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="315" y="433" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Rewind</text>
    <text x="315" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">your last swipe</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="34" y1="466" x2="356" y2="466" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="34" y="492" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Choose your plan</text>
  <rect x="284" y="478" width="72" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFF7D9"/>
  <text x="320" y="493" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">SAVE 40%</text>

  <!-- Plan cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="512" width="154" height="67" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="34" y="509" width="154" height="67" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="532" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="535" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">1 month</text>
    <text x="70" y="556" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">$24.99 / month</text>

    <rect x="202" y="512" width="154" height="67" rx="14" fill="#FFF7D9" stroke="#EFC54D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="221" cy="532" r="8" fill="#EFC54D"/>
    <polyline points="217,532 220,535 226,528" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="238" y="535" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">12 months</text>
    <text x="238" y="556" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#C42936">$14.99 / month</text>
  </g>

  <!-- CTA -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="596" width="322" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="195" y="624" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE WITH GOLD</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="662" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Recurring billing. Cancel anytime.</text>
  <text x="195" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#4396F7">Terms and Privacy Policy</text>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="143" y="764" width="104" height="5" rx="3" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".65"/>
</svg>
